verified_facts.text: The hotel spans two heritage buildings, the former KAS Bank and the Royal Dutch Post's communications center, steps from Dam Square.
verified_facts.excerpt: W Amsterdam spans two iconic heritage buildings — the former KAS Bank and the Royal Dutch Post’s communications center — just steps from Dam Square.

verified_facts.text: The former KAS Bank building was built in 1906.
verified_facts.excerpt: Check-in to the former KAS Bank to enjoy ease in the city of Amsterdam, built in 1906.

verified_facts.text: The Wet Deck pool is on the roof of the Exchange building, overlooking the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: On the roof of the exchange building, the Wet Deck is perfect to admire the city from above while chilling by the pool.

verified_facts.text: AWAY Spa is hidden in an old bank vault, a dimly lit underground haven.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hidden in an old bank vault, steam, sauna, glow, and slow down in our dimly lit underground haven.

verified_facts.text: The spa's WET area includes a heated pool, sauna, steam room, jacuzzi, Japanese fire bath and gold ice plunge pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: your next choice will be between the heated pool, sauna, steam room, jacuzzi, Japanese fire bath and gold ice plunge pool.

verified_facts.text: One suite has a snooker table that transforms into a dining table for eight.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy unique features like a snooker table that transforms into a dining area for eight.

verified_facts.text: One suite has views of the Royal Palace and Dam Square from the bed.
verified_facts.excerpt: From your W signature bed, take in stunning views of the Royal Palace and Dam Square.

verified_facts.text: Some suites have a sunken bath in the bedroom; others have an open fire and rounded bed curves.
verified_facts.excerpt: Choose your escape: a sunken bath in your bedroom or a suite with an open fire and soft, rounded bed curves

verified_facts.text: The W Lounge is a cocktail bar on the 6th floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched atop the 6th floor, the W Lounge invites you to unwind

verified_facts.text: Gold lines on the W Lounge windows and slim copper pipes pay tribute to the telephone wires of the former exchange.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bold gold lines printed on the windows of the W Lounge and over 5km of slim copper pipes pay tribute to the telephone wires and electricity lines that once exchanged information

verified_facts.text: MR PORTER is a rooftop steakhouse with house DJ sets.
verified_facts.excerpt: For the finest rooftop steakhouse restaurant with an electric atmosphere and house DJ sets, it's MR PORTER

verified_facts.text: X BANK is a concept store for Dutch art, fashion and design.
verified_facts.excerpt: X BANK has been a destination for the best in Dutch art, fashion and design

verified_facts.text: The FIT gym has a canal view.
verified_facts.excerpt: FIT: an energy-charged fitness space with a canal-view opposite AWAY® Spa

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits between the Royal Palace and the Singel Canal.
verified_facts.excerpt: Marvel at the dazzling views from our home between the Royal Palace and famed Singel Canal.

verified_facts.text: Bank building rooms use warm tones and gold accents, while Exchange building rooms lean almost futuristic.
verified_facts.excerpt: Those inside the bank building are outfitted in warm tones and gold accents, while the rooms inside the former telephone exchange leans almost futuristic

verified_facts.text: Some Bank building rooms have gold minibars shaped like small bank vaults.
verified_facts.excerpt: Some of the rooms inside the bank building have gold minibars in the shape of small bank vault, complete with copper-colored cocktail shakers.

verified_facts.text: Advance appointments are required for all spa treatments and WET area access.
verified_facts.excerpt: advanced appointments are required for all treatments and access to the WET area.

verified_facts.text: Reservations at MR PORTER and THE DUCHESS are recommended more than 24 hours ahead due to high demand.
verified_facts.excerpt: We recommend more than 24 hours advance when making reservations at MR PORTER and THE DUCHESS due to high demand.

verified_facts.text: One pet up to 20 kg is allowed per room.
verified_facts.excerpt: One pet is allowed per room, with a maximum weight of 20.0 kgs.
